description: This Java class, PersistableProductOptionValuePopulator, converts a PersistableProductOptionValue object into a ProductOptionValue object, populating its fields including descriptions and handling language localization.

classes.name: PersistableProductOptionValuePopulator
classes.description: A class that converts PersistableProductOptionValue objects into ProductOptionValue objects, handling the setting of descriptions and language localization.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates a ProductOptionValue object from a PersistableProductOptionValue source, including descriptions localized by language.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates a new ProductOptionValue instance (currently returns null).

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Returns the injected LanguageService used for language lookups.

methods.name: setLanguageService
methods.description: Sets the LanguageService used for language lookups.
